usedFor: Zoho CRM holds the accounts and deals, and Eclincher manages social posting by brand. A “New Account” in Zoho CRM can run “Create Brand” in Eclincher, which needs only a name, to set up a brand for that account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Create Brand” in Eclincher
bestTemplate.why: If you run social media for each client, a new account becomes a brand ready for posts. “Create Post” from a CRM event has no post text to work from.

watchOut: “New Account” is polling, so the brand appears on a schedule. Anything you publish later with “Create Post” reaches outside the business, so it waits in Needs you for approval.
